name: check_questionnaire_claims
description: Flags draft Meta questionnaire answers that contradict a verified build/plan inventory: hand-picked age ratings, 'privacy policy not needed', region/legal mismatches (GDPR/LGPD vs launch regions), 'no personal data at all' without on-device nuance, English-only shipping for localized regions, and 'Ready to submit' status claims. Call it before writing a compliance verdict.

draftItems: We target 10+, so we will select ESRB E10+, PEGI 12, and the lowest Brazil rating.
Privacy policy URL: not needed since no data is collected.
GDPR: does not apply — no EU users and no personal data.
